run_crystal_structure_relaxation: run crystal structure relaxation on CIF files using the UMA ML potential with a YAML config
create_uma_calculator: create a FAIRChemCalculator using the UMA pretrained MLIP model for structure relaxation
relax_single_structure: relax a single ASE Atoms crystal structure using BFGS, FIRE, or LBFGS optimizers
relax_batch_structures: relax multiple crystal structures in batch using FairchemLBFGS with optional unit cell optimization
submit_slurm_relax_jobs: submit parallel SLURM jobs to relax crystal structures from parquet files across multiple GPUs
